concerns.text: The plan does not contain any explicit dataset citation or a “Verified Datasets” block. While the research.md file lists GSM8K and bigbench_lite with URLs, the implementation plan should directly reference the datasets it will use (e.g., a short block citing the GSM8K parquet URL and the bigbench_lite HuggingFace identifier). Adding these citations ensures the plan meets the data_resources lens requirement that every dataset used be explicitly named in the artifact.
